name: Kimi to Tsunagaru Koi Flag
original_name: 君とつながる恋フラグ
source:
This is the first game by Mirage Soft. Due to a past trauma, Yuuto doesn’t have any close relationships with others and before long, he didn’t engage in any relations with girls. Then the tsukumogami Kikyou, who had been sent by the goddess of fate appeared before him.

“Let me be your cupid”

Realizing that she wouldn’t back down from her request and won’t leave until her task is done, he asked her to just go out with him instead, thinking that it would trouble her enough to concede. However, she did not have any problems with it and so they became a couple. Since they were now in a relationship, she could not return to the realm of the gods. The only way for her to return would be to form a new relationship which is deeper than the one that they had just created. That’s when he realized that only trouble lies ahead in his future.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/05/02/may-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
这是Mirage Soft的第一款游戏。由于过去的创伤，勇斗与其他人没有任何亲密的关系，不久之后，他就不再与女孩发生任何关系。这时，命运女神派来的月神桔梗出现在了他的面前。

“让我成为你的丘比特”

意识到她不会屈服于自己的要求，而且不完成任务也不会离开，他就让她和他一起出去，因为认为让步会让她很麻烦。然而，她对此没有任何问题，所以他们成为了情侣。既然已经交往了，她就不可能再回到神界了。她回来的唯一方法就是建立一种比他们刚刚建立的关系更深的新关系。就在那时，他意识到他的未来只有麻烦。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/05/02/may-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
